articles.summary: TROY, Mich., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Presurance Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PRHI) (“Presurance” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter YTD 2026 Financial Highlights Personal Lines Business Continues to Generate Profitable Underwriting Results Combined ratio for Q3 2026 improved to 82.7% from 95.2% in the prior year period. YTD 2026 combined ratio of 91.0%; a significant improvement from 119.3% for the first nine months of 2025. Improved YTD Overall Underwriting Performance Overall underwriting combined ratio improved to 97.1% for the nine months ending September 30, 2026, compared to 133.7% in the prior-year period. Book value is now $6.45 per share as of September 30, 2026. articles.title: Presurance Holdings Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results
